description: This Dart file implements a Flutter widget for an online match screen, handling WebSocket connections for real-time updates such as connection status, errors, and state synchronization. It manages WebSocket client connection, subscribes to events, and displays connection status and real-time data.

classes.name: OnlineMatchScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that represents an online match screen, handling WebSocket communication for real-time updates.

classes.name: _OnlineMatchScreenState
classes.description: The state class for OnlineMatchScreen managing connection status, WebSocket client, event subscription, and UI state.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and initiates WebSocket connection when the widget is inserted into the widget tree.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Asynchronously establishes WebSocket connection, sets up event listeners, and handles connection errors.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources by canceling subscriptions and disconnecting the WebSocket client.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the screen, displaying connection status, errors, and real-time synchronization data.
